description: Implementation of CustomerService interface providing customer-related operations such as retrieval, update, and deletion within a shopping system.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing customer management operations, extending generic entity service, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieve list of customers matching the given first name.

methods.name: getByNick (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieve customer by nickname within a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: List customers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore (with criteria)
methods.description: List customers by store with filtering criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Get customer address based on IP address, using GeoLocation service.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Create or update a customer record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a customer and associated attributes.
